data.heading: Heart
data.text: The heart is a muscle. It pumps blood around the body.
The blood carries oxygen which the body needs in order to survive.
The heart is about the size of the fist.
The human heart beats about 70 times a minute which is just over 1 beat per second. It beats about thirty-seven million times a year!
The heart is divided into four chambers: the left atrium, the right atrium, the left ventricle, and the right ventricle.
Oxygen-rich blood flows from the left atrium into the left ventricle and then around the body.
From the body, blood without oxygen flows into the right atrium. From the right atrium into the right ventricle and then to the lungs where it receives oxygen.
